dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied to refinance my home with an FHA loan for $605,000 over 30 years. Could you please tell me the status of my application? Was it approved, denied, or is it still under review?
dialogue.agent: Thank you for your inquiry. Your FHA refinancing application for $605,000 over 30 years has been approved and the loan was originated.

dialogue.user: Thank you for confirming that my application was approved! Could you please let me know what my interest rate is and if there are any high-cost (HOEPA) or negative amortization flags associated with my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your approved loan has an interest rate of 6.250%. It is not classified as a high-cost (HOEPA) mortgage, and there are no negative amortization features on your loan.

dialogue.user: Thank you for providing those details. Can you tell me what the total costs of this loan will be? Also, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution since approval?
dialogue.agent: The total costs associated with your loan are $20,180.65. After origination, your loan was sold to a credit union, mortgage company, or finance company.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. Could you please explain what my debt-to-income ratio means for my application, and what type of loan product I was approved for?
dialogue.agent:
Your debt-to-income (DTI) ratio is the percentage of your total monthly debt payments compared to your monthly income, and it helps lenders assess your ability to repay the loan. For your application, the record does not include a specific DTI ratio value.

The loan product you were approved for is an FHA first lien.
